end.summary:
Practised estimating products of large numbers by rounding first.
Worked through examples using non-zero parts and place-value zeros.
Rudra gave several multiplication responses, including 6 × 5 = 30.
The zero-placement mix-up in 500 × 60 = 3,000 was seen and was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised rounding large numbers before multiplying and then placing the zeros from the rounded factors. Rudra used the fact that 6 × 5 = 30 in some examples. There was still a mix-up when counting zeros in 500 × 60; it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise two or three examples by writing the non-zero multiplication first, then counting and attaching all the zeros carefully.
